summary: Toppoint Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing that its board approved postponing the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders from August 24 to September 8, 2026, to allow additional time to receive and review proxy materials and vote. The record date remains August 7, 2026, and proposals are unchanged. A proxy supplement and revised card will be mailed on or about August 28, 2026. This is a routine meeting-date change, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics apply.
